title: l1qw.25.3: C: wire sos_ratelimit_check into SOS rx path
description: sos_ratelimit.c:37-43 implements per-source rate limits (10 min cooldown, 3/hour, burst 2) on monotonic k_uptime:189-220, but sos_ratelimit_check has zero callers. Wire it into the SOS receive handler registered by .25.1. Exceeding limits: drop, log, do not relay (R-12-036/037/038). Test vectors: sos_rate_limiting.json. Python reference: emergency.py:31-33/:122-152.
